common.summary: `.editorconfig`, `SECURITY.md`, issue forms (bug, feature, contact links), PR template, Dependabot for pinned actions, `labels.yaml` with a Sync Labels workflow (crazy-max/ghaction-github-labeler; dry run on PRs, never deletes), Issue Triage workflow (assign maintainer, label untemplated issues), CodeQL workflow, `require-ci-success` composite action

conventional-commits.summary: `commitlint.config.mjs`, husky `commit-msg` hook, Commit Lint workflow that checks the PR title, which squash merges use as the commit (amannn/action-semantic-pull-request)

release-flow.summary: `promote.yml` that fast-forwards `main` to `staging` after CI passes and starts `publish.yml`, a `pr.yml` that requires `staging` as the base branch and runs dependency review, plus rulesets for `main`, `staging` and release tags; the `staging` ruleset requires the checks `test` (from the `node` set's `ci.yml`), `Check branch`, `Dependency review` and `pr-title`, so supply a `ci.yml` with a `test` job if you don't use `node`

npm-publish.summary: `publish.yml`, `nightly.yml`, `release-preview.yml` and `release.config.cjs`: semantic-release cuts `-rc` candidates on `staging` (nightly, when it has shippable changes) and publishes official releases from `main` to npm with trusted publishing, and comments on each pull request with the release it would cut (cycjimmy/semantic-release-action, marocchino/sticky-pull-request-comment)

npm-pages.summary: `typedoc.json`: the `npm-publish` release builds TypeDoc API docs and deploys them to GitHub Pages on official releases

vscode-extension.summary: `publish-extension.yml`, `release.config.cjs` and `scripts/vscode-release/release-version.mts`: semantic-release with VS Code's even/odd pre-release versions, publishing to the Marketplace and Open VSX with trusted publishing, and a `vsce-demos` skill for recording demo videos (add `agentic` for its symlinks)

node.summary: Dev container for Node 24, a Codecov config, a `setup` composite action (Node 24, `npm ci`, optional `--ignore-scripts`), a `ci.yml` (npm audit by risk, format check, build, typecheck, test, pack), and a slim Prettier setup (`.prettierrc.json` at 110 columns, `.prettierignore`, format-on-save `.vscode` settings and extension recommendations, a `.lintstagedrc.json` and `.husky/pre-commit` that format staged files; add `prettier`, `husky`, `lint-staged` and `build`, `typecheck`, `format` and `format:check` scripts to `package.json` yourself)

cpp.summary: `.clang-format`, `.clang-tidy`, pre-commit config, and a format check workflow (jidicula/clang-format-action, clang-format 22) that fails on unformatted files

dotnet.summary: Full `.editorconfig` with .NET and C# code style rules

rust.summary: `rustfmt.toml` and a Rust workflow with `fmt`, `clippy` and `test` jobs (stable toolchain from the runner's rustup, warnings denied, `--locked`). Needs a committed `Cargo.lock`

agentic.summary: Coding-agent config for Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Gemini and Antigravity from one source: a short `AGENTS.md` skeleton, five read-only subagent roles generated with rulesync, `delegate` and `progress-notes` skills shared through symlinks, and an Agent Config check workflow. See [Agentic Configuration](docs/agentic-config.md)

agentic-powerpack.summary: Optional, off by default: a `powerpack-sync` skill that compares the repo with this one's current patterns and proposes updates, with per-set and per-path controls in `.agents/powerpack.json`, and a `dev-powerpack-exemplars` skill that adds one tool or config to the repo by adapting this one's matching template
